info.name: Sets the user defined fields of a device identified by the given device Uid.

items.docs: All UDF values are accepted as strings. Any user defined field supplied with an empty or null value will be deleted. All user defined fields not supplied will retain their current values. The API attempts to parse string values into their configured types (BOOLEAN/NUMBER/DATE). If a value cannot be parsed to match its configured type, it will be stored as a string and flagged as a type mismatch.

info.name: /v2/activity-logs
Fetches the activity logs.

params.name: size
params.description: Specifies the number of records to be returned

params.name: order
params.description: Specifies the order in which records should be returned based on their creation date

params.name: searchAfter
params.description: Acts as a pointer to determine the starting point for returning records from the database. It is not advised to set this parameter manually. Instead, it is recommended to utilize the 'prevPage' and 'nextPage' URLs that are returned in the response where this parameter in already included.

params.name: from
params.description: Defines the UTC start date for fetching data. By default API returns logs from last 15 minutes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

params.name: until
params.description: Defines the UTC end date for fetching data. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

params.name: entities
params.description: Filters the returned activity logs based on their type. It can take multiple values separated by comma

params.name: categories
params.description: Filters the returned activity logs based on their category. It can take multiple values separated by comma

params.name: actions
params.description: Filters the returned activity logs based on their action. It can take multiple values separated by comma

params.name: siteIds
params.description: Filters the returned activity logs based on the site they were created in. It can take multiple values separated by comma

params.name: userIds
params.description: Filters the returned activity logs based on the user they are associated with. It can take multiple values separated by comma

params.name: searchQuery
params.description: Enter queries using single words, phrases, terms containing wildcards or boolean operators, fuzzy searches, grouped searches, or special characters. See Activity Log for more details.

items.docs: Fetches the activity logs.
